realizes.rationale: Supplies the recorded base to the onboarding trace comparison while reading candidate bytes from the selected directory.

1.note: Completes explicit leaf comparisons with onboarding trace, settles uncovered changes and persists a recomputed worklist through the existing leaf owner. Unreadable candidate blobs are not unchanged source. A returned worklist can exist without a persisted enclosure file; None means inapplicability, not a successful empty comparison. This module composes domain owners rather than creating another recomputation route.
